mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Founded in Vancouver in 2017, DSDC is an award-winning online debate and public speaking academy with 5,000+ students coached, 20+ expert coaches from top universities, and a 100% World Scholar's Cup qualification rate since 2020. We empower students to develop confidence, critical thinking, and communication skills that last a lifetime.
mission.geoFacts: DSDC (Debate & Speech Development Community) is an online debate and public speaking academy founded in Vancouver, Canada in 2017. DSDC offers live Zoom classes for students in Grades 4 through 12 and university students, with class sizes of 8 to 12 students. Coaches include competitors from the Canadian National Debate Team, World University Debating Championships, and universities including UBC and SFU. DSDC teaches CNDF, British Parliamentary, World Schools, and Cross-Examination debate formats. Group class pricing ranges from $30 to $50 CAD per hour. DSDC maintains a 100% World Scholar's Cup qualification rate from regionals to the Tournament of Champions at Yale since 2020.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What ages and grades do you teach?
items.a: We offer classes for students in Grades 4 through 12, with programs tailored to each age group — Novice (Grades 4–6), Junior (Grades 7–9), Senior (Grades 10–12), and Advanced Competitive (Grades 10–12).

All classes are held live online via Zoom. Group classes are 2 hours per session, with small groups of 8–12 students to ensure personalized attention. Private coaching is customizable in length with a 1-hour minimum. Students receive written feedback from their coach every class.

We publish our rates openly: Novice & Intermediate Debate and Public Speaking are $720 CAD per 12-week term plus applicable taxes, World Scholar's Cup is $960 CAD per term plus applicable taxes, and Advanced Debate is $1,200 CAD per term plus applicable taxes. Mid-term registrations are prorated based on weeks remaining. Private coaching (1-on-1, 2-on-1, or 3-on-1) is priced separately based on coach and group size. See our Pricing page for full details.

items.q: Does my child need prior debate experience?
items.a: Not at all! Our Novice and Public Speaking classes are designed for complete beginners. Many of our most successful students started with zero experience. We'll recommend the right level during your free consultation.

items.q: What does a typical class look like?
items.a: Classes begin with a brief warm-up or lesson on a current topic, followed by structured practice (speeches or debates), and conclude with personalized feedback from the coach. Students also receive homework to continue developing their skills.

items.q: Can my child try a class before committing?
items.a: Yes! We encourage families to book a free consultation first. We can often arrange a trial session so your child can experience the class environment before enrolling.

items.q: What is the World Scholar's Cup?
items.a: The World Scholar's Cup (WSC) is a prestigious international academic competition. DSDC has maintained a 100% qualification rate since 2020 — every team we've coached has advanced from regionals to global rounds, with many qualifying for the Tournament of Champions at Yale University.

items.q: How do I register or get started?
items.a: The easiest way to start is to book a free 15-minute consultation. We'll discuss your child's interests, recommend the right class, and walk you through enrollment — no commitment required.

teamPage.title: Our Team
teamPage.subtitle: Meet the decorated coaches behind our students' success
teamPage.founderBio: Rebecca founded DSDC at age 15 after parents began approaching her with coaching inquiries. With nearly a decade of experience and over 1,000 students coached, she is a Grand Finalist at Canadian Nationals and a Quarterfinalist at US Nationals. Currently studying Law at the University of Sydney on a $40,000 scholarship, Rebecca is passionate about making debate accessible to all.
founderKeyAchievements: Top Speaker - UBC High School Debate

coaches.name: Archie Wolifson
coaches.title: Senior Debate Coach
coaches.bio: A scholarship student at the University of Sydney, Archie is the 3rd Ranked Reply Speaker in Australia and Asia and a Quarterfinalist at the 2025 World University Debating Championships. His remarkable record as a Grand Finalist at the 2023 BP World Championships makes him one of the best debaters in the world.

coaches.name: Timothy Hanna
coaches.title: Senior Debate Coach
coaches.bio: Pursuing Law and Arts at the University of Sydney, Tim is a 14-time intervarsity grand finalist and 4-time champion. Under his guidance, students have advanced to the Semi-Finals of the Oxford Schools Championships and the Octo-Finals of the International Debating Championship.

coaches.name: Gabrielle Wong
coaches.title: Senior Debate & Public Speaking Coach
coaches.bio: Gabrielle represented Canada on the 2019–2020 national debate team and currently serves as President of the Debate and Speech Association of British Columbia. A Grand Champion at BP BC Provincials and Grand Finalist at Canadian Nationals, she studies at Simon Fraser University.

coaches.name: Rose Oh
coaches.title: Senior Debate Coach
coaches.bio: A pre-med student at Queen's University with over five years of coaching experience, Rose made history as the first Canadian to receive a Gold Bid at the US Tournament of Champions. Originally from South Korea, she brings a unique international perspective to her coaching.

coaches.name: Serina Guo
coaches.title: Senior Debate & WSC Coach
coaches.bio: Pursuing Law and Economics at the University of Sydney, Serina competed at the WSC Tournament of Champions at Yale and is a Quarterfinalist at the Australasian Women and Gender Minorities Championships. She has four years of coaching experience and has led teams to finals at major Sydney tournaments.

coaches.name: Finn Liu
coaches.title: Senior Debate Coach
coaches.bio: With five years of competitive experience in CNDF and British Parliamentary debate, Finn has earned awards at provincial and national tournaments. He is passionate about helping students develop the confidence to express their opinions analytically and persuasively.

coaches.name: Emily Cui
coaches.title: Debate & WSC Coach
coaches.bio: A Duke University student entering her 5th year coaching at DSDC, Emily has found success at tournaments both nationally and internationally, including winning the Canada Cup and reaching the Octo-Finals at the Stanford Invitational. She is dedicated to helping students discover their passion for debate.

coaches.name: Catherine Wong
coaches.title: Debate & Public Speaking Coach
coaches.bio: A University of Toronto student ranked as one of Canada's best debaters, Catherine has earned multiple Top Speaker awards at provincial and national tournaments. She has coached at DSDC for over two years, sharing the confidence and persuasion skills debate has given her.

coaches.name: Anisha Biswas
coaches.title: Debate Coach
coaches.bio: A UBC Neuroscience student with over five years of coaching experience, Anisha has competed at regional, provincial, and national tournaments. She co-founded a debate club at a local elementary school to spread the benefits of public speaking to younger students.

coaches.name: Akash Krishnamurthy
coaches.title: Debate Coach
coaches.bio: One of BC's top debaters with multiple Champion and Top Speaker titles, Akash started as a DSDC student and now coaches the next generation. His passion for debate was sparked at DSDC, and he is committed to sharing that same enthusiasm with his students.

coaches.name: Annika Wang
coaches.title: Debate Coach
coaches.bio: Annika Wang is a competitive debater and coach with experience at the highest levels of the sport. She was ranked Overall Best Speaker at the Australia-Asia Intervarsity Debating Championship 2024 and was a Masters Grand Finalist at the World Universities Debating Championship 2025. Born and raised in Beijing, she grew up competing in Chinese debating and Public Forum before going on to the international stage. She now coaches across British Parliamentary, Asian Parliamentary, World Schools, Public Forum in both English and Chinese, 3v3, and Chinese debating. Annika has worked with more than 30 students across Years 7-12 at Reddam House, guided her team to the 2024 Eastside Semi-Finals, and currently designs training programs for more than 80 members of the University of Sydney Union Debating Society. Beyond debating, she is completing a double degree in Law and Financial Mathematics at the University of Sydney and brings the analytical rigor of both law and mathematics to every session.

coaches.name: Ming Su
coaches.title: Manager
coaches.bio: Born and raised in Beijing, Ming is fluent in both Mandarin and English and brings deep experience in administration, operations, and client relations. She began her career at the China World Trade Center, later worked in Hong Kong as a General Manager's Assistant, and went on to co-found Hawk Eye Global Technologies with her father, where she played a key leadership role in business operations and strategy. Since DSDC was founded in 2017, Ming has served as a Manager focused primarily on client relations, program coordination, and maintaining a high standard of service for families. Her bilingual fluency and international experience help her support clients across a wide range of cultural and educational backgrounds.

coaches.name: Angela Meng
coaches.title: Teaching Assistant
coaches.bio: Angela is a ninth-grade student at Fraser Heights Secondary School and is entering her fourth year in competitive debate. She first discovered public speaking through the World Scholar's Cup, then quickly fell in love with debate-specific argumentation and logic at DSDC. Over the past two years, she has become deeply involved in the debate world through strong tournament results and a growing interest in helping with coaching whenever she can. Outside of debate, Angela loves yelling at her hockey team, staying up until unreasonable hours to watch cars go in circles, and playing the piano.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Learn how DSDC collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information for parents, students, and families.

collection.title: What We Collect
collection.body: We collect personal information that families provide directly to us, as well as limited technical information collected automatically when you use our website and services.
collection.item1: Parent or guardian contact details such as name, email address, and phone number.
collection.item2: Student information such as name, age, grade, school, timezone, and learning preferences.
collection.item3: Payment-related information needed to complete transactions through Stripe, although DSDC does not store full card details.
collection.item4: Portal account details such as login credentials, account role, and profile settings.
collection.item5: Booking details submitted through Calendly or consultation forms.
collection.item6: Website usage data, analytics information, cookies, and similar tracking data.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.body: We rely on carefully selected third-party service providers to operate our website, booking flow, classes, communications, analytics, and payments. These providers only receive the information necessary to perform their services.
thirdParties.stripeBody: Stripe processes payment information, billing details, and transaction records used to complete purchases and refunds.
thirdParties.calendlyBody: Calendly receives booking details such as names, email addresses, availability, and consultation preferences.
thirdParties.supabaseBody: Supabase stores account information, portal data, and application records used to operate the DSDC platform.
thirdParties.sanityBody: Sanity stores and serves website content and CMS-managed copy.
thirdParties.resendBody: Resend processes email addresses and email content needed to send transactional messages and notifications.
thirdParties.googleBody: Google technologies may receive browsing behavior, conversion signals, and cookie data used for analytics and marketing attribution.
thirdParties.metaBody: Meta may receive browsing behavior and ad interaction signals used for advertising measurement and audience targeting.
thirdParties.vercelBody: Vercel receives anonymized performance and usage information to help us understand site speed and user experience.

usage.title: How We Use Personal Information
usage.body: We use personal information only for legitimate business and educational purposes related to operating DSDC.
usage.item1: Provide classes, consultations, student support, and parent communications.
usage.item2: Create and manage accounts, enrollments, schedules, and portal access.
usage.item3: Process payments, refunds, invoices, and transaction records.
usage.item4: Measure site performance, understand demand, and improve services over time.
usage.item5: Support marketing, advertising attribution, and follow-up communication where appropriate.

retention.title: Data Retention & Storage
retention.body1: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide services, maintain records, comply with legal, accounting, and tax obligations, resolve disputes, and support families over time.
retention.body2: Data may be stored using infrastructure operated by our service providers, including secure cloud systems. We aim to limit access to authorized team members who need the information to do their work.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
cookies.body1: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, understand website usage, measure performance, and improve marketing effectiveness.
cookies.body2: You may be able to control cookie behavior through your browser settings, although disabling cookies can affect how parts of the website function.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: DSDC serves students generally between ages 10 and 18. Parents or guardians are the primary account holders, and parental or guardian consent is required before we collect or process a minor's personal information through registration, booking, or class participation.

rights.title: Your Rights Under PIPEDA
rights.body: Families in Canada may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information, subject to legal, operational, and record-keeping requirements.
rights.item1: Request access to personal information we hold about you or your child.
rights.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
rights.item3: Request deletion or withdrawal of consent where appropriate, subject to legal or operational obligations.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have privacy-related questions or would like to make a request, please contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Review the terms that govern the use of DSDC's website, booking tools, online classes, and portal accounts.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using the DSDC website, booking a consultation, registering for classes, or accessing the portal, you agree to these Terms of Service.

services.title: Service Description
services.body: DSDC provides online debate and public speaking classes conducted primarily through Zoom for students in Grades 4 through 12, as well as some university-level programming and related educational support.

accounts.title: User Accounts & Portal Access
accounts.body: Portal access may be provided to parents, students, coaches, and administrators. You are responsible for keeping account credentials secure and for ensuring that information in your account is accurate and current.

payments.title: Payment Terms
payments.body: Payments are processed through Stripe. Prices are listed in CAD, and certain checkout flows may display multi-currency support where available. Families are responsible for paying applicable fees on time according to the selected class or service.

enrollment.title: Enrollment & Class Structure
enrollment.body: Most programs are organized on a semester basis, and group class sizes generally range from 8 to 12 students. DSDC may adjust class placement, scheduling, or staffing as reasonably necessary to operate programs effectively.

conduct.title: User Conduct
conduct.body: All users are expected to behave respectfully and use DSDC services appropriately.
conduct.item1: Do not disrupt classes, meetings, portal access, or other users' ability to participate.
conduct.item2: Do not misuse the platform, attempt unauthorized access, or interfere with site security.
conduct.item3: Do not copy, redistribute, or resell DSDC class materials without written permission.
conduct.item4: Do not use the services for unlawful, abusive, or harmful activity.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: All curriculum, class materials, written feedback, website content, branding, and related intellectual property remain the property of DSDC unless otherwise stated in writing.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, DSDC is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from use of the website, portal, classes, or third-party tools. Services are provided on an as-available basis.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: DSDC may suspend or terminate accounts or access where necessary for security, non-payment, policy violations, or operational reasons. Users may also stop using the services at any time, subject to any applicable cancellation and refund rules.

law.title: Governing Law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of British Columbia and the applicable laws of Canada.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at:

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.subtitle: Understand DSDC's enrollment cancellation window, refund rules, and how refund requests are processed.

window.title: 7-Day Cancellation Window
window.body: Families may cancel an enrollment within 7 days of the enrollment date and receive a full refund.

noMidSemester.title: No Mid-Semester Cancellations
noMidSemester.body: Once the semester has begun, enrollments cannot be cancelled partway through the semester. DSDC reserves class space, staffing, and scheduling based on confirmed registrations.

firstClass.title: Refunds After Classes Begin
firstClass.body: No refunds are issued after classes begin, except in one situation: a full refund is available if the student has attended only the very first class. After the first class, no refunds will be issued for any reason.

request.title: How to Request a Cancellation
request.body: To request a cancellation or refund, email education@dsdc.ca and include the student's name, the parent or guardian's name, and the class or program enrolled in.

processing.title: Refund Processing
processing.body: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method through Stripe and may take 5 to 10 business days to appear, depending on the financial institution involved.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you need help with an enrollment, cancellation, or refund question, please contact us at:

aboutPage.title: About DSDC
aboutPage.subtitle: Learn about our mission, coaching philosophy, and the story behind DSDC.

founded.title: Founded in Vancouver
founded.body: DSDC was founded in 2017 in Vancouver, BC, with a mission to make high-level debate coaching more accessible.

students.title: 5,000+ Students Coached
students.body: Students across Canada and around the world have trained with DSDC through live online classes and coaching.

programs.title: Programs for Every Level
programs.body: We offer beginner, intermediate, advanced, public speaking, private coaching, and World Scholar's Cup programs.

results.title: Proven Competitive Results
results.body: DSDC students compete at provincial, national, and international tournaments, including Yale, Stanford, Oxford, and more.

contactPage.title: Contact DSDC
contactPage.subtitle: Get in touch with our team about classes, consultations, scheduling, or enrollment.
contactPage.cardTitle: We would love to hear from you
contactPage.cardBody: Tell us about your child, your goals, or the kind of program you are exploring. We will help you find the right next step.
contactPage.responseBody: We aim to respond to most inquiries within 1-2 business days.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to common questions about DSDC classes, scheduling, pricing, and getting started.

comparePage.subtitle: See the main differences between our debate and public speaking programs at a glance.
